(4) The Board administering the affairs of the Corporation
shall cause a register of members of the Corporation to be
kept. There shall be inscribed in such register the name of
every person who, at the date of the coming into operation
of this Act, is a member of the Association and the name of
every person who is thereafter duly enrolled as a member of
the Association.
